name: Harvard University
description: Harvard University is a private Ivy League research university in Cambridge, Massachusetts, founded in 1636 as the first college in the American colonies. It comprises Harvard College and twelve graduate and professional schools.
whyIncluded: Among the most-searched overseas universities from Singapore in 2025 (KiasuParents); the Harvard Club of Singapore serves a community of over 2,400, and Harvard Medical School is on the Singapore Medical Council's list.

livingCosts.notes: Harvard College 2026-2027 cost of attendance (on-campus, 9-month academic year). Yearly: housing $14,250, food $8,942, personal = estimated personal expenses $2,500 + estimated books $1,000 = $3,500. Transport 0: 'Estimated transportation costs $0-$5,000' depends on home location. Excludes tuition, fees and health insurance ($4,954).

programmes.name: SM in Computational Science and Engineering (SEAS)
programmes.notes: SEAS CSE master of science: full-year tuition $67,504 for the one-year programme (2026-27 GSAS cost of attendance). Fees = HUSHP Student Health Fee $972/term x 2 terms + $35 Harvard Griffin GSAS Student Council fee; Student Health Insurance Plan ($2,477/term, waivable) excluded. 2024 from the 2024-2025 GSAS page (SHF $796/term); no archived 2025-26 SEAS rate found, so no 2025 entry.

programmes.name: SM in Data Science (SEAS)
programmes.notes: SEAS Data Science SM: $67,504 first year + $33,752 second year (one term only) = $101,256 over 1.5 years, divided by 1.5. Fees = HUSHP Student Health Fee $972/term x 2 terms + $35 Harvard Griffin GSAS Student Council fee; Student Health Insurance Plan ($2,477/term, waivable) excluded. 2024 from the 2024-2025 GSAS page (SHF $796/term); no archived 2025-26 SEAS rate found, so no 2025 entry.

programmes.name: MBA (Harvard Business School)
programmes.notes: HBS 2026-27 cost of attendance, single student, 9-month academic year: tuition $84,760; fees = HUHS Student Health Fee $1,944. Student Health Insurance Plan ($4,954, waivable), housing and food excluded. 2024 and 2025 tuition from Harvard OIRA Fact Book (FY2025 = 2024-25 $76,410, FY2026 = 2025-26 $78,700); fees for those years not found so current value applies.

programmes.name: Master in Public Policy (Harvard Kennedy School)
programmes.notes: HKS 2026-27 MPP: tuition $64,340; fees = course materials fee $618 + HKS student activity fee $250 + HUHS Student Health Fee $1,944. SHIP ($4,954, waivable) excluded. 2025 from the HKS 'Tuition & Fees From Previous Year' page (tuition $61,926; fees $618 + $250 + $1,800). 2024 tuition from Harvard OIRA Fact Book (Government, FY2025 $59,316); fees not found.

programmes.name: JD (Harvard Law School)
programmes.notes: HLS 2026-27 Standard Student Budget (9-month): tuition $84,400; fees = Mandatory HUHS Student Health Fee $1,944 (waivers generally not available). Harvard University Student Health Insurance Plan ($4,954, waivable with comparable coverage), housing and food excluded. JD is graduate-entry (3 years). 2025 from the same page's 2025-2026 Cost of Attendance table; 2024 tuition from Harvard OIRA Fact Book (Law School, academic year 2025 = 2024-25); 2024 fees not found.

programmes.name: MD (Harvard Medical School)
programmes.notes: HMS 2026-27 MD cost of attendance, Pathways curriculum Year 1 (10-month): tuition $76,828 (same for all four years and for the HST track); fees = university health service fee $1,944 + disability insurance fee $72 + student activities fee $150 + education materials fee $645 (Year 1 Pathways; $314-$907 in other years/tracks) + technology fee $900. Health insurance fee ($4,954, waivable), books, living expenses and board exam fees excluded. MD is graduate-entry (4 years). 2025 tuition from the same page's 2025-26 tables (fees not itemised there); 2024 tuition from Harvard OIRA Fact Book (Medical School, academic year 2025 = 2024-25).
